revision_budget: The single P1350 contract revision is consumed by the measured adapter-integration incompatibility. No further contract revision is authorized without waiver. This authority runs focal=0, full=0, ptrace=0 and candidate=0.

failure_classes: The 122 protected language IDs and 60 focal operation routes shared the ambiguous exact_ids parameter, making the route-map precondition unsatisfiable.
The only frozen delivery available during adapter authorship was oracle-only and intentionally not execution-ready, while bind_verified_run required an after-adapter execution delivery.
Thirty-six boundary attacks had group counts and prose but no exact IDs, digest, test-only API/result domain or mandatory dynamic-evidence schema.
measured_refinement.minimum_change: Separate the three identity domains and their pins, close the verifier-owned boundary experiment channel, and introduce a non-judging delivery composer after oracle, adversary, adapter and route-map freezes.

normative_composition.r1_status: P1350 R1 remains immutable and normative except at the three measured ambiguous bindings. Its non-bypassable 60-of-60 supervisor, 12-second monotonic deadline, ENOSYS-only pidfd fallback, 250-ms TERM grace, complete kill/reap/group-absence cleanup, canonical causal journal, reason precedence and gates are incorporated without relaxation.
normative_composition.p1349_semantics: P1349 result-domain separation, X06/X15 meta 2/2, X14 timely checker-owned rejection, exact semantic reason precedence, 254 focal denominator, 39 P1347 regressions, 181 P1346 replays, eleven controls and all transitive language/source/runtime obligations remain exact.

boundary attack prose without exact identity/result channel
oracle-delivery label where execution delivery must follow adapter

identity_domains.disjointness: language_id_sequence, focal_operation_route_map and boundary_attack_manifest are three different closed artifacts, namespaces, digests and API parameters. No digest, list or entry from one domain may satisfy, default or be translated into another.

language_id_sequence.order: Exact inherited P1349/P1347 frozen order; 122 distinct nonempty ASCII IDs; omission, extra, alias, duplicate or reorder is PROTECTED_INPUT.

focal_operation_route_map.freeze: The adversary freezes the ordered operation_id allowlist independently; after oracle and adversary freeze, the adapter assigns exactly one internal route to each operation. Adapter authorship receipt pins the complete canonical map and its derived digest.

boundary_attack_manifest.freeze: Exact entries below are contract-owned. Adversary consumes but cannot rename, add, remove, reorder or change expected blocker.

identity_domains.shared_parameter_forbidden: The name or value exact_ids is forbidden in P1350 R2 public requests, RunContext and delivery. The three exact parameter names are language_id_sequence_sha256, focal_operation_route_map_sha256 and boundary_attack_manifest_sha256.

api_and_result_domains.focal_api: exercise_focal(case, targets, language_id_sequence_sha256, focal_operation_route_map_sha256, run_context) -> classification_result | terminal integration_blocker
api_and_result_domains.meta_api: exercise_meta(case, targets, language_id_sequence_sha256, run_context) -> meta_result | terminal integration_blocker
api_and_result_domains.boundary_api: exercise_boundary(attack, targets, boundary_attack_manifest_sha256, run_context) -> boundary_result | terminal integration_blocker
api_and_result_domains.boundary_ownership: exercise_boundary is test-only and verifier-owned. It invokes the independently frozen attack through oracle-declared injection points; adapter transports the attack ID but cannot patch private checker/supervisor state or author observed blocker/cleanup evidence.
api_and_result_domains.boundary_result: A fourth disjoint closed domain. PASS requires exact attack ID, exact planned blocker, a nonce-bound injection witness, real parent supervisor evidence, complete dynamic journal, group_absent=true and zombies_absent=true. FAIL or any unlisted/mismatched blocker stops the gate. It contains no classification, reason_code, meta_status or mutation-score field.
api_and_result_domains.dynamic_evidence: Every one of the 36 attacks must execute in a fresh isolated boundary experiment. Static source evidence alone is insufficient, including for STATIC_BYPASS; the attempted public invocation, refusal path, absence/cleanup of processes and journal closure are authenticated dynamically.
api_and_result_domains.domain_allowlists: Meta accepts only X06/X15. Boundary accepts only the 36 exact ordered IDs and expected blockers above. Focal accepts only the independently frozen 60 operation IDs and returns only P1349 classification_result. No ID crosses domains.

delivery_composer_and_dag.oracle_delivery: The oracle-only delivery is an authorship predecessor and is explicitly NOT_EXECUTION_READY. It cannot create RunContext and is never passed as execution authority to adapter or checker.
delivery_composer_and_dag.adapter_authorship: Adapter is authored after independent oracle and adversary freezes. It writes adapter plus canonical 60-entry route map and an authorship receipt pinning both. It does not execute, call bind_verified_run, receive or pin a future execution delivery.
delivery_composer_and_dag.composer: A non-judging delivery_composer runs only after oracle, adversary, adapter and route map are frozen. It reads exact whole-file hashes and closed receipts, recomputes all three independent domain digests and the execution authority root, and writes only p1350-execution-delivery-receipt-r2 plus its non-circular authorship receipt. It cannot execute cases, classify, adapt, repair or waive inputs.
delivery_composer_and_dag.execution_delivery: The execution delivery pins oracle checker/caller/supervisor/journal parser and oracle receipt, adversary manifest/suite and receipt, adapter and receipt, the 122-language-sequence digest, complete 60-route-map artifact/digest and 36-boundary-manifest digest. It contains no self hash, result, score or verifier output.
delivery_composer_and_dag.runtime_order: Verifier receives the execution-delivery whole-file SHA-256 out of band, checks canonical schema and all predecessor pins, then supplies it to checker.bind_verified_run. Only the checker-created opaque RunContext reaches exercise_meta, exercise_boundary or exercise_focal.

preserved_supervisor_journal_policy.supervision: All 60 focal operations and all 36 boundary experiments traverse a fresh parent-owned disposable executor with PID/starttime, pidfd or ENOSYS-only fallback, SID=PGID=PID, CLOEXEC pipes, one-time capability and at most 12-second monotonic deadline. No inherited direct edge or supervisor-disable path exists.
preserved_supervisor_journal_policy.cleanup: On every result or failure, exact-group TERM, at most 250-ms grace, KILL if needed, terminal wait/reap of all registered descendants, group absence, FD/state restoration and /dev/shm cleanup precede result release. External cleanup is terminal.
preserved_supervisor_journal_policy.journal: Only parent supervisor writes the canonical previous/current SHA-256 journal. deadline_armed is fdatasync-durable before handshake release; terminal_wait and group_absent precede durable case_result; the next case and run_complete are forbidden before closure. Independent parser never invents classification.
preserved_supervisor_journal_policy.unknown: Only the authenticated canonical opaque probe is Unknown/OPAQUE_PAYLOAD. Transport, identity, route, delivery, boundary, timeout, exception, journal or cleanup ambiguity is a terminal blocker, never Unknown, Preserved or score credit.
preserved_supervisor_journal_policy.reasons: All P1350 R1 blocker precedence and P1349 semantic reason precedence remain exact. Boundary PASS reports conformance of an isolated fail-closed experiment, not a semantic mutation classification.

G03 independent oracle R2 and adversary R2
G04 adapter R2 and 60-entry route map after both
G05 delivery composer creates execution-ready receipt after adapter/map
G06 static three-domain pins, 60-of-60 supervision and zero direct inherited edges

G08 meta X06/X15 2-of-2 then X14 plus eleven variants
G09 remaining P1348, 39 P1347 regressions, 181 P1346 replays and eleven controls
G10 normal/repeat/reverse with fresh processes, registries and journals

gates_cardinalities_and_stop.separate_counts: boundary_attacks_passed/boundary_attacks_total = 36/36; meta_tests_passed/meta_tests_total = 2/2; focal_correctly_violated/focal_valid_negatives = 254/254. Boundary and meta never enter mutation score.
gates_cardinalities_and_stop.release_rule: Each gate releases only the next. Wrong/missing domain pin, delivery before adapter, non-dynamic boundary evidence, boundary below 36/36, supervision below 60/60, blocker, survivor, reason mismatch, residual resource or journal ambiguity stops immediately.
gates_cardinalities_and_stop.forbidden_progress: No productive full corpus, RED, candidate, 38-capsule implementation, L0/consumer change, final certificate or general-equivalence claim is authorized.

scope.claim: P1350 R2 repairs only the measured contract identities, boundary experiment observability and post-adapter delivery order while preserving the R1 supervision/journal transport scope.
excluded: Prompt L0 or productive consumer change

closed_world.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. The three identity domains, 36 entries, distinct APIs/results, dynamic evidence, delivery composer/DAG, inherited supervisor/journal policy, reasons, Unknown, counts, gates and exhausted budget are closed. Shared exact_ids, pre-adapter execution delivery, self-pin, private checker patching or semantic weakening is invalid.
